description: This PHP source file defines the SaleReturn controller class for the OpenCart admin report extension, handling sale return report display, saving report settings, and generating report data with pagination.

classes.name: SaleReturn
classes.description: Controller class for handling sale return reports in the OpenCart admin panel, including display, save, and report generation functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the sale return report form page with breadcrumbs, configuration, and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of sale return report settings via POST request, with permission check.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the sale return report with filtering options and return statuses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the sale return report list data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the sale return report data with pagination and filtering.
